items.html: And understand this: why the middle aspect is called Yetzirah (Formation), and the aspect of VAK; and why they said that the Yenika is from the aspect of VAK, when it would have been fitting to say that they are only three edges, like the Ibur, which was three lower edges, NHY. However, it is called VAK because they are the VAK of the middles that are completed in one time together — behold, this is one reason, for the ChGT themselves; and also the externality was completed into VAK, as mentioned — behold, this is the second reason. And also, because these are the aspect of the VAK, the Yenika of all the Gadlut in general.
